records.question: What caused the April 2026 ledger reconciliation mismatch, and which change fixed it?

claims.text: The April 2026 ledger reconciliation mismatch was caused by a timezone handling error introduced in CHG-1072. CHG-1074 fixed the issue by deploying a correction script that converted UTC+2 timestamps to UTC, aligning the affected entries with the correct settlement times and fixing the import logic.

records.question: How was the slow report export problem of February 24, 2026 fixed?

records.answer: CHG-1025 refactored report exports as background jobs

claims.text: The slow report export problem of February 24, 2026 was caused by report generation logic running synchronously within web request handlers, which were subject to a 30-second request timeout, causing exports of more than 100,000 rows to fail.
CHG-1025 was implemented to fix the issue by refactoring report exports as background jobs, removing the dependency on the request timeout and allowing exports of any size to complete successfully.

With CHG-1025, when a merchant requests a report export, the merchant-portal service queues the export as a background job and processes it asynchronously. Once complete, the notifications service sends an email to the merchant containing a download link.
CHG-1025 was deployed by Jonas Berg on 2026-02-26 and was approved by Hannah Kim, lead of the Merchant Experience team.
